explanation: This is an unfolding (simp) lemma for the library's own definitions. `homUnitLinearEquiv`, `unitObjZeroLinearEquiv` and `unit` are all defined in TauCeti/Algebra/Category/GradedVectorSpace/Basic.lean, so the content of the lemma is in those definitions and Mathlib cannot have a matching declaration. The proof uses only `simp` lemmas from the library itself and then `rfl`.
